failure: Failure: It constrains a stated local transport class. It does not establish that a particular strange metal obeys that class or identify a microscopic mechanism.
interface: Interface: The affine law, common material, stated boundary conditions, local Ohmic model, independent Johnson sources, quasistatic electrical response, and a frequency band where mean temperature fluctuations are frozen are required. Mixed materials, arbitrary nonlinear resistivity, thermoelectric terms, and endpoint attainability in every fixed geometry are excluded.

claims.title: Affine resistivity gives a frozen-temperature noise identity and sharp bounds
